summary: iter63 — Full backend + frontend verification of the (1) AI Load Hunter, (2) LTL Rate Cards, (3) AR Aging engine, (4) Ops KPIs 'daily' margin series, and (5) carrier brochure PDF. All 18 pytest cases PASS (100%). All 5 Playwright UI flows PASS: AI Hunter tab renders mode pills (balanced/high_margin/high_volume), scan populates 8 winner cards with 6-component score bars + book/dismiss buttons, autobook toggle + cap input present, risk registry shows Kraft Heinz with CREDIT FLAG, audit toggle expands to show RISK REJECT rows and toast 'Scan complete — 8 winners from 53 loads'; LTL Rates tab renders 6 quote rows with RLCA discount persisted at 42.5 from the backend test; Accounting tab shows AR engine panel with buckets ($3,947 current / $2,500 1-30) + 4 customer rows with CLEAN flags + Auto-Invoice Delivered + Sync Risk Flags buttons both fire (Sync toast: '0 shipper(s) credit-flagged'); Ops KPIs page /brokerage-ops-kpis renders daily-margin-chart; Drivers tab carrier-brochure-btn downloads Orisei_Carrier_Partner_Brochure.pdf (225,764 bytes, valid %PDF header). Hunter config reset to balanced + auto_book_enabled=false at the end.

minor.issue: Inline discount 'update' requires the full CardIn payload (carrier_name, fsc_pct, min_charge_usd all required). Frontend fetches the whole card, mutates one field, then POSTs — works. But naming the endpoint 'upsert' + returning 422 for a partial patch feels un-RESTful. Consider adding PATCH /api/ltl/cards/{card_id} that accepts a single field.

critical_code_review_comments: load_hunter.py — best_carrier populated correctly after dispatch_carriers seed. All 6 score components (margin_pct, shipper_reliability, lane_profitability, fuel_economics, detention_risk, driver_match) present in every winner. Weights change with mode as expected (balanced → margin=0.25, high_margin → margin=0.40).

ltl_rate_cards.py — _rate_card math produces exactly one cheapest=true flag; net_total_usd + suggested_sell_usd + margin math all present. Six carriers auto-seeded (RLCA, SAIA, DYLT, ODFL, CNWY, EXLA).

ar_aging.py L122-176 auto_invoice_run is idempotent — second POST returns created=0 (verified via test). Bucket labels are 'current'/'1_30'/'31_60'/'61_90'/'90_plus'. Kraft Heinz seeded with credit_flag=true in shipper_risk registry.
orisei_ops_kpis.py — 'daily' array populated with 30 entries; each has revenue_usd/margin_usd/loads keys.
carrier_brochure.py — 225KB PDF (>100KB target), 6 pages, Content-Type application/pdf, %PDF magic bytes valid.

Brokerage.jsx (2414 lines) — EXCEEDS 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into per-tab files (DashboardTab, DriversTab, AccountingTab, FormsTab, etc.) — same suggestion carried over from prior iters. Non-blocking.
LoadHunterTab.jsx toast on scan says '8 winners from 53 loads in 17.4ms' — good UX.
Load boards are MOCKED (DAT/Truckstop/123LB feeds are synthetic) — expected per review_request note.
Dunning email send is logged-only (Resend key missing) — expected per review_request note.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/dispatch/carriers/seed (session autouse fixture, already-existing=11). Reset hunter config to {mode:balanced, auto_book_enabled:false, min_score:80, max_rate_usd:3000, max_per_day:5} on teardown as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter63 target flows all pass. Response shape gotchas for next agent: /api/load-hunter/winners returns {items,count} not {winners}; /api/ltl/cards returns {items,count,weight_breaks,classes,accessorial_codes} not {cards}; /api/load-hunter/config returns nested cfg.auto_book.enabled (not flat cfg.auto_book_enabled). POST /api/ltl/cards requires the FULL CardIn schema, not a partial patch — send the existing card back mutated. Booking a winner twice returns 400 'Already booked' (this is why auto-book side-effects from prior scans can block re-testing — filter winners by status!='booked'/'dismissed'). AR mark-paid + remind require an invoice id from aging.customers[i].oldest_invoice_id (there is no /api/ar/invoices GET endpoint).
